visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright living room with a black leather couch, a white dining table, and a glass coffee table. Through a large sliding glass door, the turquoise ocean and sandy beach of the Gold Coast are visible under a clear sky. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom. (2) The camera pans across a balcony with two dark grey chairs and a white round table, overlooking a shoreline with crashing white waves. A small black helicopter is seen flying in the distant sky. (3) A screen recording shows a hotel booking interface with the title 'Zenith Ocean Front Apartments Gold Coast'. (4) A montage follows showing a white kitchen with a built-in oven, two bedrooms with light-colored unmade beds, and a laundry room with a white washing machine and dryer. (5) The scene shifts to external facilities: an underground parking lot with a white MG car, a small gym with various weight lifting machines, a fenced outdoor tennis court, and a stone-tiled BBQ area. (6) A high-angle shot shows four people lying on blue lounge chairs by a bright blue outdoor swimming pool. A woman in a white bikini walks slowly into the water. (7) The woman, now in a black t-shirt and jeans, sits on the balcony ledge looking at the ocean. (8) Close-up shots highlight a dark, dimly lit bathroom, a metal shower head, and a hand feeling thin, patterned bedsheets. A weather app screen showing 12 degrees is briefly visible. (9) A hand points to travel-sized shampoo bottles on a white towel, a cream-colored plastic trash bin, and a white drying rack laden with dark laundry. (10) The final shot shows the woman standing on the balcony, holding a smartphone to photograph the ocean horizon.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 8月 (澳洲冬季). [Slogan]: 黃金海岸 超便宜的海景飯店. (2) [Subtitle]: 這個景色 竟然一晚不到1000? (3) [Logo]: 聖母海灘. [Slogan]: Zenith Ocean Front Apartments Gold Coast - Official Listing. (4) [Subtitle]: 這間位於 Surfers Paradise 的 Zenith Oceanfront Apartments. (5) [Subtitle]: 擁有海景第一排 整片落地窗. (6) [Subtitle]: 甚至是雙陽台 採光超級好. (7) [Subtitle]: 客廳餐廳廚房都超級大. (8) [Subtitle]: 有兩間房間. (9) [Subtitle]: 分別是雙床房 跟一間附衛浴的套房. (10) [Subtitle]: 也有自己的洗衣機跟烘乾機. (11) [Subtitle]: 馬桶跟洗澡間 也是分開來的. (12) [Subtitle]: 除了房間超大外 還附有一個車位. (13) [Slogan]: 免費健身房 網球場、BBQ. (14) [Slogan]: 室內桑拿熱水池 跟戶外泳池. (15) [Subtitle]: 這樣的神級住宿 一個人一晚竟然只要不到台幣 1000. (16) [Slogan]: 約 TWD 27,318 AUD 1,396.50 澳洲8月4人住7晚 平均976/晚. (17) [Variety]: 欸! 缺點要來囉. (18) [Subtitle]: 首先就是 超老舊裝潢. (19) [Subtitle]: 跟有時候 會有小蟑螂的環境. (20) [Subtitle]: 但這個是最小的問題. (21) [Subtitle]: 畢竟在海景前 住破一點又如何. (22) [Logo]: BUT. (23) [Subtitle]: 晚上洗澡 竟然熱水會用完. (24) [Slogan]: 需要等老舊熱水器蓄水. (25) [Subtitle]: 害我第一晚直接 12度洗冷水澡. (26) [Subtitle]: 洗完回房間發現 被子竟然只是 薄薄的一條被單. (27) [Subtitle]: 上面也只加了也是 薄薄的一條被子. (28) [Subtitle]: 冷到發抖 想開暖氣發現. [Variety]: 完全沒有風. (29) [Subtitle]: 房間根本沒有空調. (30) [Subtitle]: 整間唯一的 冷暖氣在客廳. (31) [Subtitle]: 好險隔天 跟飯店反映後 有多給毯子 我才活了下來. (32) [Subtitle]: 然後是 什麼都要錢. (33) [Subtitle]: 沐浴備品要錢 衛生紙要錢 垃圾袋要錢 換毛巾要錢. (34) [Subtitle]: 那我們自己洗毛巾 才發現 烘乾機竟然是壞的. (35) [Variety]: 至少還能曬乾啦. (36) [Subtitle]: 趕快跟櫃台說免得 以為是我們弄壞 又要錢. (37) [Subtitle]: 總之雖然缺點一堆 我還是會 推薦你們住在這間. (38) [Subtitle]: 因為這個超美的海景 到底誰拒絕得了.

The speaker's voice becomes more exaggerated and varied in pitch, conveying frustration in a lighthearted way. (6) The video ends with a final enthusiastic summary statement from the narrator as the music loops and fades.
